scenes.title: Sela's warning
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver, refuses night travel, and offers to meet at first light tomorrow. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang and repeats her grandmother's account of warm water.

scenes.title: The flooded mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black floodwater, loose hymn-book pages, and a penciled "M. Brand" signature; Teo identifies the handwriting as Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement, without confirmation; Oren takes two damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary: A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother takes children near the water. At midnight, twelve underwater bell strokes accompany louder humming and pale congregation-like shapes; the shapes disappear when the bell stops, and the party leaves.

scenes.title: Tomorrow we dive
scenes.summary: The party plans a first-light boat ride with Sela and a daytime low-tide chapel dive; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest that restores everyone to full.
